task.prompt:
Write a PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL stored procedure.

The exact procedure name and parameter list are:
sp(para_Year_Join integer, para_Country text, para_Artist_ID integer, para_Exhibition_ID integer, para_integer text)

The procedure returns no result set. It must be written in PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL.

Use the attached SQL core file (core.sql) as the procedure body template. Replace each placeholder in that file as follows:

<arg1> -> para_Year_Join
<arg2> -> para_Country
<arg3> -> para_Artist_ID
<arg4> -> para_Exhibition_ID
<arg5> -> para_integer

Use the attached constants dictionary (constants.md) for the values of every { ... } placeholder in the SQL core.

The procedure has no explicit exception handling; any database error is not caught and propagates to the caller.

Return the complete stored procedure, and nothing else.

materials.text:
# Constants

- `{ARTIST_COUNTRY_COMPLETION_MARKER}`: Country value assigned to remaining artist rows with the completion Year_Join., value = 'complete'
- `{ARTIST_COUNTRY_INITIAL_FIRST}`: Country value assigned to all artist rows before the first initial deletion., value = 'A'
- `{ARTIST_COUNTRY_INITIAL_SECOND}`: Country value assigned to remaining artist rows after the first initial deletion., value = 'B'
- `{ARTIST_COUNTRY_INITIAL_THIRD}`: Country value assigned to remaining artist rows after the second initial deletion., value = 'C'
- `{ARTIST_COUNTRY_PHASE2_FIRST}`: Country value assigned to all remaining artist rows before the first second-phase deletion., value = 'phase2_A'
- `{ARTIST_COUNTRY_PHASE2_SECOND}`: Country value assigned to remaining artist rows before the second second-phase deletion., value = 'phase2_B'
- `{ARTIST_COUNTRY_PHASE2_THIRD}`: Country value assigned to remaining artist rows before the third second-phase deletion., value = 'phase2_C'
- `{ARTIST_YEAR_JOIN_COMPLETION_SELECTOR}`: Year_Join value selecting remaining artist rows for the final completion update., value = 999
- `{ARTIST_YEAR_JOIN_INITIAL_DELETE_FIRST}`: Year_Join value used to delete the first initial artist cohort., value = 1
- `{ARTIST_YEAR_JOIN_INITIAL_DELETE_SECOND}`: Year_Join value used to delete the second initial artist cohort., value = 2
- `{ARTIST_YEAR_JOIN_INITIAL_DELETE_THIRD}`: Year_Join value used to delete the third initial artist cohort., value = 3
- `{ARTIST_YEAR_JOIN_PHASE2_DELETE_FIRST}`: Year_Join value used to delete the first second-phase artist cohort., value = 101
- `{ARTIST_YEAR_JOIN_PHASE2_DELETE_SECOND}`: Year_Join value used to delete the second second-phase artist cohort., value = 102
- `{ARTIST_YEAR_JOIN_PHASE2_DELETE_THIRD}`: Year_Join value used to delete the third second-phase artist cohort., value = 103
- `{ATTENDANCE_INCREMENT}`: Increment amount added to exhibition_record.Attendance for all remaining rows., value = 1
- `{EXHIBITION_ID_COMPLETION_SELECTOR}`: Exhibition_ID value selecting remaining exhibition_record rows for the final completion update., value = 999
- `{EXHIBITION_ID_INITIAL_DELETE_FIRST}`: Exhibition_ID value used to delete the first initial exhibition_record cohort., value = 1
- `{EXHIBITION_ID_INITIAL_DELETE_SECOND}`: Exhibition_ID value used to delete the second initial exhibition_record cohort., value = 2
- `{EXHIBITION_ID_INITIAL_DELETE_THIRD}`: Exhibition_ID value used to delete the third initial exhibition_record cohort., value = 3
- `{EXHIBITION_ID_PHASE2_DELETE_FIRST}`: Exhibition_ID value used to delete the first second-phase exhibition_record cohort., value = 101
- `{EXHIBITION_ID_PHASE2_DELETE_SECOND}`: Exhibition_ID value used to delete the second second-phase exhibition_record cohort., value = 102
- `{EXHIBITION_ID_PHASE2_DELETE_THIRD}`: Exhibition_ID value used to delete the third second-phase exhibition_record cohort., value = 103
- `{EXHIBITION_RECORD_INTEGER_COMPLETION_LOG}`: Integer column value assigned to remaining exhibition_record rows with the completion Exhibition_ID., value = 'complete_log'
